answers.how: The fish is approximately 215 px long and moves approximately 180 px/s. Its length is 215 × (0.67/180) ≈ 0.80 m.
The fish's transverse width is approximately 80 px. Using the motion-derived scale, its width is 80 × (0.67/180) ≈ 0.30 m.
The fish moves approximately 90 px from 0.5 s to 1.0 s. Applying the motion-derived scale gives 90 × (0.67/180) = 0.335 m.
